home.heroTitle: Find the part you need — and we'll source it when it isn't on the shelf.
home.heroText: Browse in-stock parts with photos, specs and prices. Can't find it? Request sourcing for any brand; price and lead time are confirmed before you pay.
home.otherBrandsHint: Request sourcing for any other brand
home.step1Text: Send the part name, vehicle and, if you can, a photo or file.
home.step2Text: An expert reviews it and issues a quote with price and lead time.
home.step3Text: Sourcing starts only after you accept the quote and the payment is verified.
home.step4Text: Follow progress in your account and the conversation.
home.faq1q: Which currency are prices shown in?
home.faq1a: Prices are shown in Iranian rial (IRR) or UAE dirham (AED). Online payment settles the final amount in IRR, which you always see before paying.
home.faq2q: What if my part is not in stock?
home.faq2a: Submit a sourcing request. You'll receive a quote with price and lead time; nothing is sourced until you pay.
home.faq3q: Do I need a VIN to submit a request?
home.faq3a: No. VIN and part code are optional and only help our experts review the request.

pages.aboutBody: Source works with a mission of “precise, fast and smart sourcing” of auto parts: selling in-stock parts with transparent specifications, and sourcing parts for any brand with price and lead time confirmed before payment.
pages.contactChat: The fastest way to reach us is the on-site conversation.
pages.policyPending: This text will be published once approved by the owner.
pages.buyingBody: Search for an in-stock part, check its specs, type and condition, and add it to your cart. After signing in with your mobile, choose an address and shipping method and see the final IRR amount before paying. Stock is reserved for you for a limited time once payment starts.
pages.sourcingBody: Submit a request with the part name, vehicle and, if possible, a photo or file. An expert asks questions in the conversation and issues an official quote with items, price and lead time. Every change creates a new quote version. After you accept and the payment is verified, sourcing starts and progress shows in your account.
pages.notFoundHint: The address may be wrong, or this part is no longer published. Search the parts in stock or send a sourcing request for any brand.
pages.errorHint: This problem has been logged on our side. Please try again; if it continues, contact support.
